title: XPRS
description: XPRS - stations heard over the air, and the packets they sent.
summary: Every station this device has heard over a radio bearer - Bluetooth, LAN or LoRa - and never over the internet, plus a live trace of the XPRS packets seen and which bearer carried each one. Traffic addressed to other stations is shown too, because on a mesh that is most of what goes past. Read-only: it transmits nothing.
